title: Two writers on one SQLite file

concepts.description: Write-ahead logging lets readers continue while a writer is active, at the cost of extra files and a checkpointing step.
concepts.context: several Claude sessions plus the git hook share one knowledge.db, so WAL is what keeps a read from blocking behind a write

concepts.description: A busy timeout waits for a lock to clear; it does not help when two writers try to upgrade to a write transaction at the same instant, which fails immediately instead.
concepts.context: retryOnBusy exists because busy_timeout = 5000 does not cover the simultaneous-upgrade case

concepts.description: A retry is only safe if the failed attempt left no partial effect; transaction rollback is what provides that guarantee here.
concepts.context: the comment argues the retry is safe for writes because a busy transaction has already rolled back
